The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Clan Bralor/Legends|Bralor clan]] owned a '''farm''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="ImpCom501st" /> the cultural [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Mandalorians located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Clan Bralor's [[Farm/Legends|farm]] was situated north of Mandalore's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], and a few [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from [[Kyrimorut/Legends|Kyrimorut]], the home of [[Clan Skirata]]. During the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the subsequent [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in its place, the farm was home to the [[Gender/Legends|female]] Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Rav Bralor]] and her niece, [[Parja Bralor]]. Following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Bralor farm came to house the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] deserters of [[Yayax Squad]], whom Rav Bralor had trained on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] during her time as member of the ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]''.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Bralor's farm was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe via a mention in the [[2009]] novel, ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'', the fifth in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]] [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Karen Traviss]].
